verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Privacy Portal that detects and classifies customer data, general privacy tooling for HIPAA, GDPR and CCPA, and Consent Management for end-user preferences. None of it documents per-destination hashing, masking, or field-level filtering of sensitive attributes. Functions are only a developer building block that could be used to construct such transforms, and detection/classification and consent enforcement are adjacent features, so neither earns credit for this story.
